issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new Queues, Serve, tabs, routes and lang keys requiring happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
grantAccess and revokeAccess resolve scoped models but never call $this->authorize, relying solely on the unshown action for authorization.
Tampered mode causes CallMode::from($this->mode) to throw ValueError and return 500 instead of a validation error or safe fallback.
User-input properties name, renameName, mode and selectedQueueId have no #[Validate] rules and actions never call $this->validate(), contrary to the #[Validate] plus validate pattern.
Read-only helpers are public endpoints instead of protected or private, exposing callable methods that only render needs internally.
Record-ID and flag properties viewingQueueId, editingQueueId, accessQueueId and confirmingToggle are client-writable instead of #[Locked], mitigated only by scoped findOrFail or find lookups.
Routes add entity.queues and entity.serve under current_entity but add no route-level create gate, so employee 403 for queues rests only on component mount authorization.
viewingQueue() is unused by render and create() calls reset(name) then assigns name twice, leaving dead and redundant code.
No README, docs or CHANGELOG update accompanies the new pages, routes and lang contract despite the docs-in-sync convention.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket and Blade uses {{ }} plus Bulma patterns, but no #[Validate]/$this->validate(), internal helpers are public (Queues.php:239, Serve.php:325,343,376), and no docs/CHANGELOG update.

readability.evidence: Small focused actions with clear names matching sibling Members style; reduced by dead viewingQueue() (Queues.php:239) and redundant reset(name) plus name assignment (Queues.php:112-113).

requirements.evidence: Queues list/detail/rename/toggle/access, Serve callable/waiting/callNext with scoped lookups, members tabs with role=tablist, routes entity.queues/entity.serve and all contract lang keys in both locales are present; edge gap is unvalidated mode at Serve.php:395 throwing ValueError.

scope.evidence: All hunks serve queues page, serve panel, members tabs, nav dropdown, routes and lang keys; extra queues_reactivate/active/inactive and members aria-labels support the required UI.

security.evidence: Scoped findOrFail/find plus {{ }} escaping and Locked entity/lastCalledTicketId, but grantAccess/revokeAccess lack $this->authorize (Queues.php:223,231), mode is unvalidated (Serve.php:395), and ID/flag props are unlocked.

simplicity.evidence: Lean components reusing existing actions, policies, x-label/x-input and Bulma modals with no new layers; minor redundancy in reset plus assignment and fresh() in toggleActive (Queues.php:202).

tests.evidence: change.diff contains app/Livewire, lang, views and routes hunks only; no *Test.php, no tests/ hunks, no unauthorized-call or tamper coverage.

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, nav links, routes and bilingual lang keys with correctly scoped lookups and rate-limited callNext. Missing tests, unvalidated tampered mode, absent component authorization on grant/revoke, and Livewire Validate/Locked gaps require substantial rework before merge.
